summary: This informational RFC registers the text/markdown media type, so that files in Markdown, a family of plain-text formatting syntaxes that can be converted to HTML and other markup, can be labeled correctly when sent over the Internet.

eli5.summary: Markdown is a simple way to write bold and headings with plain symbols. This gives it an official label so computers know what kind of file it is.

questions: what is the mime type for markdown
